description: Test suite for the Pod Garbage Collector (GC) controller in Kubernetes, including tests for terminated, orphaned, unscheduled, and terminating pods, as well as metrics verification and patch/deletion logic.

methods.name: alwaysReady
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the controller is always ready for testing.

methods.name: NewFromClient
methods.description: Creates a new PodGCController and associated informers using the provided Kubernetes client and threshold.

methods.name: TestGCTerminated
methods.description: Tests the garbage collection of terminated pods based on different thresholds and pod states.

methods.name: makePod
methods.description: Helper to create a pod with specified name, node, and phase.

methods.name: waitForAdded
methods.description: Waits until the queue has the specified number of items.

methods.name: TestGCOrphaned
methods.description: Tests garbage collection of orphaned pods with various node and pod configurations.

methods.name: TestGCUnscheduledTerminating
methods.description: Tests deletion of unscheduled terminating pods.

methods.name: TestGCTerminating
methods.description: Tests garbage collection of pods on nodes that are not ready or tainted out-of-service.

methods.name: TestGCInspectingPatchedPodBeforeDeletion
methods.description: Verifies that orphaned pods are patched with DisruptionTarget condition before deletion.

methods.name: verifyDeletedAndPatchedPods
methods.description: Checks that the set of deleted and patched pods matches expectations.

methods.name: testDeletingPodsMetrics
methods.description: Verifies that the metrics for deleting pods are correctly updated.

methods.name: setupNewSimpleClient
methods.description: Creates a fake Kubernetes client with specified nodes and pods for testing.

methods.name: getDeletedPodNames
methods.description: Extracts the names of pods that have been deleted in the fake client actions.

methods.name: getPatchedPodNames
methods.description: Extracts the names of pods that have been patched in the fake client actions.

methods.name: resetMetrics
methods.description: Resets the metrics counters for pod deletion and errors.
